name: ClickUp
one_liner: Project management platform; ClickUp API lets teams build custom workflows, integrations, and automations.
auth_notes: Personal API token in the Authorization header for individual use; OAuth flow for apps that other users authorize per Workspace.
access_notes: Personal token for personal use; OAuth for apps other people use, which authorizes Workspaces. Pages fetched do not state cost, plan requirement for credentials, or OAuth app-creation gating.

buildability.rationale: Documented public API with personal token and OAuth; rate limits and endpoint availability vary by Workspace plan. Credential gating and OAuth app setup were not confirmed by fetched pages.
